rubric.evidence: Verified directly against W3C WebGPU §25.25, W3C WGSL §4.1.1 / §6.2.8 / §17.8.6, GPUWeb proposal atomic-64-min-max.md, PR #5610, Blink gpu_supported_features.idl and dawn_enum_conversions.cc, Dawn/Tint wgsl.def (confirming void-returning atomicStoreMin and atomicStoreMax on storage read_write atomic<vec2<u32>>), BCD, webstatus.dev, and ChromeStatus 4882016087703552 on 2026-11-27.
